messages:
Sam: Pushed a perfetto trace from a high-latency tail run. Client->gateway->runtime spans look OK but there's a 40-90ms tail inside the runtime where KV cache prefetch + kernel selection stalls. Link: https://perfetto.dev/trace/0a1b2c
Maria: Hmm, can you upload the nsys capture too? I want to see kernel timelines and CPU->GPU sync points.
Sam: Uploaded nsys tar to s3: s3://redwood-perf/trace-kvcache-1798765432.tar.gz
Jun: Quick observation: in the perfetto timeline there's a repeating pattern of tiny gaps after the prefetch RPC that line up with `cudaStreamSynchronize` in the nsys. Might be host-side waits.
Lee: Also seeing kernel selection thrash — fallback kernels (fp32) interleave with quantized (int8) ones when the batch size changes from 1->4. Could be our heuristic re-picking kernels on KV miss.
Maria: Can you paste the nsys cli you ran?
Sam: Sure:
```
nsys profile --stats=true -t cuda,cudnn --capture-range=nvtx --output kvcache_ns  --trace-fork-before-exec=true ./bin/runtime_perf --trace perfetto
```
Jun: From nvprof-ish output: frequent small GEMM launches at ~5-20us each; kernel launch overhead adds up when batching isn't coalesced.
Sam: I tried a controlled run where I disabled kv prefetching and the tail reduced by ~30ms. But throughput or latency distribution for cold keys got worse.
Lee: Sounds like prefetching trades tail latency for hot-path throughput. We need to adjust prefetch depth and whether it triggers kernel re-selection.
Maria: Can we add a metric to mark when kernel selector re-compiles/picks a new kernel per request? If we can correlate that with perfetto span tags we'd be golden.
Sam: Agreed. I have a patch that emits an NVTX event before/after kernel selection. Attaching small perfetto snippet:
```
track_event: kernel_select start
... runtime kernel_select (duration 1.2ms)
track_event: kernel_select end
```
ops-bot: Deployed build sha abc123 to perf cluster with NVTX enabled :rocket:
Jun: After NVTX-tagged run, the perfetto surfaces a cluster: kernel_select occurs right after KV prefetch for ~25% of requests; those correlate with higher launch latency and an extra CUDA sync.
Maria: Next steps: (1) add a guard to avoid kernel re-selection when prefetch toggles batch size within 10ms window, (2) tune prefetch depth down to 2, (3) run nsight with instr-level timeline for 1000 requests.
Sam: I'll open a PR with the NVTX + guard change and attach perf numbers. Short-term mitigation: lower prefetch depth on dedicated GPUs.
Lee: Thanks — if you can include a small micro-bench that simulates typical gateway batching distribution that'd help validate.
Sam: On it. I'll post results here by EOD. :eyes:
